snippet.title: Clickhold - Demo Release
snippet.description:
Hello! This video showcases the release of the Clickhold demo!

Hope you enjoy it and give the game a try. Let us know what you think!

🎮 Play the demo: store.steampowered.com/app/5141930/

Thanks for watching!
